**jmadkour.org** is an educational website on statistics and econometrics, designed for students from the bachelor’s through the doctoral levels. The goal: to make these disciplines **clear, visual, and interactive**.

The site is constantly being updated. Every week, new chapters, proofs, and exercises are added.

## Support the Project

The site is free and will remain so. If you’d like to support its development, you’ll soon be able to do so via a donation link—thank you in advance.
